INSERT INTO arc.items(source,source_ref,item_type,title,raw_text,project_key,status,metadata,content_sha256)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,'triaged',$7::jsonb,$8)
ON CONFLICT (source, content_sha256) WHERE content_sha256 IS NOT NULL
DO UPDATE SET updated_at=now()
RETURNING id,source,item_type,title,raw_text,project_key,status,metadata;

parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('project_key',project_key,'display_name',display_name,'priority_weight',priority_weight,'lifecycle',lifecycle,'objective',objective,'policy',policy) ORDER BY priority_weight DESC),'[]'::jsonb) AS portfolio FROM arc.projects WHERE lifecycle IN ('active','parked');

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_build_object('project_key',project_key,'display_name',display_name,'priority_weight',priority_weight,'objective',objective,'policy',policy,'metadata',metadata) FROM arc.projects WHERE project_key=$1),'{}'::jsonb) AS project;
